title: The Real Alert
intro: Another alarming message. After this chapter you might report everything.
But some alerts are real, and ignoring them is risky too.
Sniff it. Is it a threat, or your bank doing its job?

notify.text: Was this you? Card payment €480 at 03:12

screen.context: Your phone showed a notification from the banking app you use every day. You opened the app yourself.

p.text: We paused a card payment of €480 to an online shop at 03:12.
Was this you? Tap Yes or No below.
We will never ask for your PIN, passwords or codes.
If you tap No, we'll block the card and send a new one.

inapp.label: Inside the bank app
inapp.lens: You opened the real app yourself.
inapp.why: Alerts inside your real app are hard to fake.

subject.label: "Was this you?"
subject.why: Normal wording for a fraud check.

answer.label: Yes or No only
answer.lens: It only asks Yes or No.
answer.why: No codes, no links, no transfers.

nocode.label: Never asks for codes
nocode.lens: It says it never asks for PINs or codes.
nocode.why: Honest banks remind you of this.

card.label: Blocks the card for you
card.lens: They'll block it and send a new one.
card.why: The bank does the work; you move no money.

actions.label: Tap "No, it wasn't me" in the app
Call the number on the back of your card
Ignore it, it must be a scam

go_ahead.line: The card was blocked and a new one is on its way. The €480 never left.

block_report.line: It was the real bank. Ignoring a real alert let the €480 payment go through later.
block_report.mirageSays: Panic or ignore, I win either way!

verify.line: The bank confirmed it was a real alert and blocked the card.

what_if.block_report: It was inside your real app and asked only Yes or No. Real alerts deserve a response.

golden_rule: Real alerts live inside your real app and only ask you to confirm. They never ask for codes or transfers.

options.text: It was inside your bank app and asked only Yes or No

quick_check.explain: Where it appears and what it asks matter most.

hints.nudge: Where did this alert appear, and what does it ask you to do?

rows.k: Do they ask for PINs or codes?

rows.v: They block the card and send a new one
